SNL Hosting Debut

Actor Inde Navarrette made her hosting debut on *Saturday Night Live* this past weekend. Known for her recent role in the film *Obsession*, Navarrette utilized the platform to showcase her comedic range through a series of sketches and an opening monologue.

Monologue Highlights

During her opening remarks, Navarrette discussed her physical preparation for an upcoming role as Rogue in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). She addressed recent discourse surrounding the show, specifically referencing a comment made by Shane Gillis during his own hosting appearance. Navarrette joked about her fitness routine, stating, “So, every morning, I put on my little whore outfit and hit the gym,” referencing Gillis' previous monologue.

Additional segments featured during the episode included:

  • Cast Appearances: Marcello Hernandez, Kam Patterson, Jeremy Culhane, Veronika Slowikowska, and Grace Reiter participated in various sketches.
  • Character Sketches: Navarrette appeared as a ghost alongside Hernandez in a 1930s-themed segment, and performed an impersonation of a social media-viral personality in a fake Delta Airlines commercial.
  • Themed Parodies: The episode featured a "Dating Show" sketch and a dark comedy piece titled *The Inventor*, which explored a deceased spouse's final creation.

Musical Guest

Gracie Abrams served as the episode's musical guest, marking her second appearance on the long-running sketch show following her initial debut in 2024.

Verification

Readers interested in viewing the full sketches or the opening monologue can visit the official *Saturday Night Live* YouTube channel or the NBC streaming platform. Viewers can also check the official NBC *SNL* social media channels for clips and cast updates to verify specific episode content.
